name: gNMI (OpenConfig Reference)
description: gRPC Network Management Interface (gNMI) specification and reference implementation. Includes a caching gNMI collector with Docker support for aggregating telemetry from multiple targets.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile for gnmi_collector in cmd/gnmi_collector/docker/. Alpine-based image with supervisor. Listens on tcp/8888 by default.

eval_notes: Reference gNMI implementation. While not NETCONF, gNMI is the modern alternative for YANG-based config management. Docker-packaged collector for multi-target telemetry aggregation. Canonical gNMI protocol definition and reference implementation. 732+ dependent projects.
